question.text: Complete the statement beginning: When turning into a road with pedestrians in its crosswalk, stop.

answer.text: When turning into a road with pedestrians in its crosswalk, stop and remain stopped until they clear the lanes you will travel through.

recap.narration_text: Signals and turning lanes. Do not flash a turn signal to tell a following driver that it is safe to pass. For a right turn, give advance notice, approach in the right lane near the curb or road edge, and yield to bicyclists continuing straight in a bicycle lane. Finish a right turn in the right lane. Where several marked lanes turn together, finish in the corresponding receiving lane. For a left turn, signal early and approach from the far-left lane in your direction or the provided turn lane. Keep the wheels straight until the turn begins. Before a left turn, yield to opposing vehicles, including bicycles, and to pedestrians crossing either road. When signs, signals and a safe opening permit the left turn, finish in the receiving lane nearest the centerline or center lanes. With multiple turn lanes, use the corresponding receiving lane. After entering the intersection for a left turn, do not switch lanes within the intersection. When turning into a road with pedestrians in its crosswalk, stop and remain stopped until they clear the lanes you will travel through.
